strings.59-ФЗ, статья 12, часть 1: рассмотрение: Federal Law No. 59-FZ, Article 12, part 1: reviewing a submission within the scope of competence.
strings.Авторское учебное изложение закона: Author's training summary of the law
strings.В вымышленном деле отдельное согласие ра: In the fictional case, separate consent permits the child’s name and event photograph. The public table additionally contains health-related restrictions, which are not listed. The school has provided no other basis for dissemination in the case materials.
strings.В данном упражнении счёт начинается со с: In this exercise, counting starts on the day after registration; a deadline falling on a non-working day moves to the next working day. This is a separate task about the deadline for the specified action, not about fully resolving the real-life problem.
In the original scenario, consent was general. Here it is separate but limited to a different list; the mere existence of the document does not settle the issue.
strings.В согласии названы имя и фотография. В о: Consent names a first name and photograph. The public post also contains health restrictions. A separate form does not extend consent to every data category.
strings.В этой смене вы готовите проект решения: In this shift, you prepare a draft decision for the authorized head and organizational steps for the specified body. You do not order inspections or penalties on behalf of another agency. No real messages are sent.
strings.Важны и отдельная форма, и конкретные ка: Both the separate form and the specific categories, conditions and scope of dissemination matter.
strings.Выясните, что именно произошло и что под: Establish exactly what happened and what the materials confirm.
strings.Граждане и все материалы инцидента вымыш: The citizens and all incident materials are fictional. Any conditions of a particular service given here are a training model, not a quotation from real regulations. Act within your role. The calendar task concerns only the action it specifies.
strings.Для проверки нужно разослать таблицу все: The table must be sent to all parents for the review.
There is evidence of public access.
strings.Завершить проверку, не читая перечень в: End the review without reading the consent’s list of categories
strings.Задача не сводится к признанию любой обр: The task is not simply to declare all processing unlawful.
strings.Зафиксировать способ доступа без новой о: Record the access method without publishing the data again
strings.Имя и фотография с мероприятия. Про здор: The name and a photograph from the event. The list says nothing about health.
strings.Какая категория не охвачена представленн: Which category is not covered by the submitted list?
Which category is not covered by the submitted list? Link the extracted information to the decision based on the materials.
strings.Какой вывод подтверждается сопоставление: Which conclusion is supported by comparing the materials?
strings.Кому относится ваше требование?: Whose data does your request concern?
strings.Крайний день рассмотрения обращения: Last day for reviewing the submission
strings.Любая отдельная подпись разрешает публик: Any separate signature permits publication of all information about a child.
strings.Мне показали отдельное согласие на публи: They showed me separate consent for publishing celebration photos. But the website has a health-restrictions table next to the children’s names. Does signing for a photo allow that too?
strings.Найдите применимое положение, проверьте: Find the applicable provision, check its connection to the materials and justify the action. Training material is not a normative legal act.
strings.Найдите статью об особенностях обработки: Find the article on the processing of personal data authorised for dissemination and the limits of the relevant consent.
strings.Не заменяет специальную норму: Does not replace a special provision
strings.Обращение рассматривается в пределах ком: An appeal is considered within jurisdiction; any special procedure requires a separate check. General written-reply periods are not the same as deadlines for repairs, benefits or register corrections.
The scope of consent is limited.
strings.Ограничить распространение сведений о зд: Restrict dissemination of the health information and explain the basis for publication.
strings.Отдельная форма согласия не покрывает да: A separate consent form does not cover data outside its list; the basis for disseminating the health information specifically must be checked.
strings.Отправлено {{sent}}, поступило {{receive: Sent on {{sent}}, received on {{received}}, registered on {{registered}}. The latest event in the materials is dated {{observed}}. Do not confuse the complaint deadline with the service deadline or the time needed to resolve the problem.
strings.Первый фрагмент пересказывает условие за: The first passage restates the task conditions, not real regulations or a website extract. The external link verifies the legal basis, not the incident's facts.
strings.Перечень внутри согласия можно не читать: There is no need to read the list within the consent.
strings.По прямой ссылке без входа, я проверила: Through a direct link without signing in; I checked in another browser.
strings.Подготовить материалы для уполномоченног: Prepare materials for the competent personal-data protection unit and information for the data controller on restricting the identified dissemination.
strings.Подготовить рассмотрение по распростране: Prepare a review of data dissemination beyond the stated scope
strings.Полномочия и минимизация данных проверяю: Authority and data minimisation are being checked.
strings.Помощник: «Отдельность согласия важнее т: Assistant: “Separate consent matters more than what it lists.”
strings.Последующий результат проверен по сущест: The subsequent result has been checked against the substance of the case.
strings.Прекращение работы без выяснения обстоят: Stopping work without clarifying the circumstances
strings.Признать всё опубликованное разрешённым: Treat everything published as authorised because the document says “consent”.
strings.Проверена доступность таблицы без автори: Access to the table without authentication has been verified. A copy containing other children’s data is placed in the protected part of the case file; no public circulation is needed.
strings.Проверить ограничение доступа к самой та: Check access restrictions on the table itself, not just the website menu
strings.Проверить правовое основание для дополни: Check the legal basis for the additional data category without redistributing the evidence.

Check the legal basis for the additional category of data without redistributing the evidence. In the original story, consent was general. Here it is separate, but limited to a different list; the existence of a document does not in itself resolve the issue.
strings.Проверить, содержатся ли оставшиеся свед: Check whether the remaining entries contain health information and what basis covers its dissemination.
strings.Профиль исчисления этого упражнения: исх: This exercise's calculation profile excludes the starting day and rolls the deadline forward, using the federal five-day working week. It is not a rule for every procedure.
strings.Процедура предоставления услуги вместо о: A service-delivery procedure instead of reviewing a submission
strings.Публично разместить таблицу в качестве д: Publish the table as evidence of the violation.
strings.Разместить таблицу в общем обсуждении ро: Post the table in the parents’ shared discussion
strings.Рассмотрение обращения по закону № 59-ФЗ: Review of a submission under Law No. 59-FZ
strings.Сведения о другом заявителе, объекте или: Information about another applicant, facility or period does not replace verification in this case. A body's name does not grant an employee unlimited powers.
strings.Сначала определите действие, для которог: First identify the action to which the deadline applies. Applying for a service, registering a complaint and resolving a problem are not the same event.
strings.Согласие было на фотографию · проверка о: Consent covered a photograph · checking the basis
strings.Сообщить представителю дальнейший порядо: Explain the next steps to the representative and protect other children’s data
strings.Сопоставить категории в согласии с опубл: Compare the categories in the consent with the published table
strings.Сопоставьте вывод с документами и провер: Compare the conclusion with the documents and check the limits of authority.
strings.Существенное обстоятельство продолжения: A material circumstance in the continuation was left unchecked.
strings.Считать любую оставшуюся таблицу безопас: Treat any remaining table as safe after the diagnosis name is removed.
strings.Только обстоятельства данной вымышленной: Only the circumstances of this fictional situation
strings.Требовать от родителя публично подтверди: Demand that the parent publicly confirm the diagnosis.
strings.Участник вымышленной учебной ситуации: Participant in a fictional training situation
strings.Учебное продолжение. Оператор удалил сто: Training follow-up. The data controller removed the diagnoses column but left individual dietary and activity restrictions.
strings.Учебный материал; ссылка ведёт к правово: Training material; the link leads to the legal basis
strings.Что именно перечислено в согласии?: What exactly is listed in the consent?
strings.Я законный представитель одного ребёнка;: I am the legal representative of one child; I submit supporting documents securely.
